元力波动弥漫，传出双拳交击的炸响声，掀起飞扬的石屑，林无缺被一拳轰中胸口，他的身影倒退三丈，方才止住身形。
不过十四五岁的少年模样，皮肤白皙，林无缺长相俊秀，尤其是一双眸子似是天生璀璨，为其尚显稚嫩的脸庞增添了一抹奇异的魅力。
只是此刻的林无缺略显狼狈，武衫披肩的黑发飘扬，也不看演武台上那个将他三招就击败的对手，而是闭上了双眼，面无表情，似乎沉浸在了自己的世界里。
“林无缺，淘汰！慕容海，胜，进入下一轮！”
随着巨大演武台后传出的声音，站立在演武台上的慕容海跳下演武台，刀疤脸，身材魁梧，年方十八。
一脸傲然，慕容海眼神扫过紧闭双目的林无缺，其中的快意和蔑视不加掩饰，他在走过林无缺身旁时，突然轻轻笑了。
“林无缺，我真是有些佩服你了，十年了，你有算过自己败过多少次了么？哦，对了，我忘了，你这样的废物估计连胜利是个什么滋味都忘了吧，呵呵，真是个....垃圾啊。”
“废无缺首战竟然被轮到和慕容海一组，活该他倒霉！”
“三招废无缺就被击败，啧啧，真弱啊！”
“唉，废无缺十年来无数战斗从来没胜过一场，还屡败屡战，整整十年啊！真是个奇葩！”
围绕在巨大演武场的左方，传出叽叽喳喳议论声音的是百十来个年纪不过十一二岁的少男少女，身穿的都是统一制式裁剪得体的淡蓝色武衫，每张年轻的脸庞上都闪耀着灿烂与蓬勃，似是早上刚刚初升的太阳。
这一切，闭上眼睛的林无缺似乎早已习惯，只是没有人知道，此刻他体内正发生着翻天覆地的变化！
这变化，纵然是已经沉寂十年、心炼如铁，意志被打磨通透的林无缺甚至都有些微微颤抖，内心激荡如潮，来自灵魂深处地悸动愈演愈烈，恨不能仰天长啸！
“皇天不负有心人！寂灭十年，今朝得偿所愿，我终于是成功了么？”
........“哈哈，冰兰，我领先一步，你可不要落后。”
早已变作灿烂笑脸的慕容海来到了演武场右边端坐数十个年轻强者的石凳处，对着端坐在最前方的一位少女笑道。
随着他的到来，道道饱含战意和炽热的目光共同集中在了他的身上，同样不少强大的波动席卷而起，皆是属于端坐在这里慕容家这一代的年轻强者。
“慕容海，胜了林无缺那个废物让你很开心么？你的实力增长的确很快，竟然突破到锻体八重天，不过和天哥相比，你还差得远。”

一道略带冷意的女儿声响起，正是来自被慕容海称作冰兰的那个少女，此女虽然端坐在石凳之上，但一双盘在一起的修长美腿却形成一个魅惑的弧度，她身着红色的贴身绸裙，胸前点缀朵朵花绣，盈盈一握的小蛮腰挺得笔直，尖尖的下巴上是一双好看至极的凤眼，琼鼻挺翘，嫣红双唇，是个极为出色的美人儿。
慕容海听到冰兰的话后，笑容一滞，眼中闪过浓浓地忌惮和妒意，呵呵一笑，倒也不再言语，走到自己的石凳上闭眼端坐。
而那些盘坐在慕容冰兰身后的年轻强者在听到“天哥”这两个字之后，几乎面色同时浮现出一抹羡慕和崇敬。
“下一场，慕容冰兰对慕容杰。”
与此同时，一道中气十足的男子声音从演武台之后传出，这声音甫一响起，整个演武场突然一阵寂静，因为这是属于慕容家主慕容长青的声音。
“咻咻”
两道年轻身影顿时从石凳之上跃起，向着演武台冲去，一阵香风袭过，慕容冰兰俏立在长宽五十丈的演武场之上，在她对面站着的是一个长相中等的少年，他的目光扫过慕容冰兰的脸庞闪过一丝迷醉和爱恋。
慕容冰兰，慕容双姝之一！
资质不俗，长相美丽，气质更是冷艳逼人，不知是多少慕容子弟心中的女神，望着眼前的美人儿，慕容杰甚至有些局促和紧张，原先站在演武场上紧闭双眼的林无缺此刻睁开了眼，十年来练就的绝强意志很好的控制了情绪，他的眸子一如既往的平静，看了看场上站立的二人，径直走下演武场，不过慕容冰兰扫过他的目光却是藏着一股深深的屈辱和厌恶。
“开始。”
“轰”“嘭”
慕容冰兰和慕容杰爆发大战。
走下演武场的林无缺虽然内心仍旧激荡，但他慢慢走到演武场之后的位置，对着端坐在那里的十道人影正当中的一位拱手一摆。
“长青叔叔，无缺先走一步，回去修炼了。”
少年的声音清亮，夹杂着悠扬，似乎刚刚的一败没有对他造成任何的阴影。
“嗯，无缺，你先回去吧。”
慕容长青眼神当中透着一抹复杂之意，眼前这个拱手而立的俊秀少年在十年前，是多么的惊才绝艳？
虽然林无缺并非出自慕容家，但自从十一年前那个人将年仅四岁的他托付给慕容家并留下那样东西后，慕容长青便没有将林无缺视作外人，更是发觉其修炼天赋堪称妖孽！

Waves of Yuan Power filled the air, and there was an explosion of fists clashing, sending up flying stone debris. Lin Wuque was hit in the chest by a punch, and his figure fell back three feet before he stopped.
However, he looked like a fourteen-year-old or fifteen-year-old boy with fair skin. Lin Wuque had a handsome appearance, especially a pair of eyes that seemed to be born with brilliance, adding a strange charm to his still immature face.
It's just that at this moment, Lin Wuque looked a little embarrassed, with his black hair flying in his martial arts shirt. He didn't look at the opponent on the martial arts stage who defeated him in three moves. Instead, he closed his eyes, his face expressionless, and seemed to be immersed in his own world.
"Lin Wuque, eliminated! Murong Hai wins, enters the next round!"
Following the sound coming from behind the huge martial arts stage, Murong Hai, who was standing on the martial arts stage, jumped off the stage. He had a scarred face, a burly figure, and was only eighteen years old.
With an arrogant look on his face, Murong Hai glanced at Lin Wuque, who had his eyes closed, with no concealment of pleasure and contempt. When he walked past Lin Wuque, he suddenly smiled softly.
"Lin Wuque, I really admire you. In the past ten years, have you counted how many times you have been defeated? Oh, by the way, I forgot. A waste like you has probably forgotten what victory feels like. Haha, you are really... rubbish."
"Fei Wuque was paired with Murong Hai in the first battle. He deserves to be unlucky!"
"He was defeated even if he failed in three moves. Tsk, tsk, he's so weak!"
"Oh, in the past ten years, Fei Wuque has never won a single victory in countless battles. He has been defeated and defeated again and again for ten years! What a weird thing!"
Surrounding the left side of the huge martial arts arena, there were chattering voices from about a hundred boys and girls who were no more than eleven or twelve years old. They were all wearing uniformly tailored light blue martial arts shirts. Each young face was shining brightly and vigorously, like the sun that had just risen in the morning.
Lin Wuque, who closed his eyes, seemed to be used to all this, but no one knew that earth-shaking changes were taking place in his body at this moment!
This change made Lin Wuque, who had been silent for ten years, whose heart was as hard as iron, and whose will was polished and polished, even tremble slightly. His heart was agitated like a tide, and the throbbing from the depths of his soul became more and more intense. He wished he could look up to the sky and scream!
"The emperor has paid off! After ten years of silence, I have finally achieved what I wanted. Have I finally succeeded?"
........"Haha, Binglan, I'm one step ahead, don't fall behind."
Murong Hai, who had already turned into a bright smile, came to the stone bench on the right side of the martial arts arena where dozens of young strong men were sitting, and smiled at a girl sitting in the front.
With his arrival, Tao Dao's eyes full of fighting spirit and blazing focus on him, and many powerful fluctuations swept across, all belonging to the young and powerful generation of the Murong family sitting here.
"Murong Hai, are you happy that you defeated that good-for-nothing Lin Wuque? Your strength has indeed increased very quickly, and you have even broken through to the eighth level of body training, but compared to Brother Tian, you are still far behind."
A slightly cold daughter's voice sounded, and it came from the girl Murong Hai called Binglan. Although this girl was sitting on the stone bench, her slender legs were intertwined to form a charming arc. She was wearing a red close-fitting silk skirt, with floral embroidery on her chest. She had a straight waist, a pair of extremely beautiful phoenix eyes on her pointed chin, a straight nose, and bright red lips. She was an extremely outstanding beauty.
After hearing Binglan's words, Murong Hai's smile froze, and his eyes flashed with deep jealousy and jealousy. He chuckled and said nothing. He walked to his stone bench and sat down with his eyes closed.
When the young and powerful men sitting cross-legged behind Murong Binglan heard the words "Brother Tian", a touch of envy and reverence appeared on their faces almost at the same time.
"The next match will be Murong Binglan versus Murong Jie."
At the same time,A powerful man's voice came from behind the martial arts stage. As soon as this voice sounded, the entire martial arts arena suddenly became silent because it belonged to the head of the Murong family, Murong Changqing.
"咻咻"
Two young figures immediately jumped up from the stone bench and rushed towards the martial arts stage. A gust of fragrant wind blew past. Murong Binglan stood pretty on the fifty feet long and wide martial arts stage. Standing opposite her was an average-looking young man. His eyes swept over Murong Binglan's face, and a trace of intoxication and love flashed across her face.
Murong Binglan, one of the Murong Shu!
She has good qualifications, beautiful appearance, and even more charming temperament. She is the goddess in the hearts of many Murong disciples. Looking at the beauty in front of him, Murong Jie even felt a little embarrassed and nervous. Lin Wuque, who had closed his eyes while standing in the martial arts arena, now opened his eyes. , the strong will he had cultivated over the past ten years controlled his emotions very well. His eyes were as calm as ever. He looked at the two people standing on the field and walked straight down the martial arts field. However, Murong Binglan's eyes swept over him, but there was a deep sense of humiliation and disgust hidden in her eyes.
"Start."
"Boom" "Bang"
Murong Binglan and Murong Jie broke out into a fight.
Although Lin Wuque was still agitated in his heart when he walked down from the martial arts arena, he slowly walked to the position behind the martial arts arena and waved his hand to one of the ten figures sitting there.
"Uncle Changqing, take the first step and go back to practice."
The young man's voice was clear and melodious, as if the defeat just now did not cast any shadow on him.
"Well, Wu Que, you go back first."
There was a complex meaning in Murong Changqing's eyes. How amazing and talented was the handsome young man standing in front of him ten years ago?
Although Lin Wuque was not from the Murong family, since that man entrusted the four-year-old him to the Murong family eleven years ago and left such things, Murong Changqing did not regard Lin Wuque as an outsider, and even found that his cultivation talent was nothing short of a monster!
